posts.title: Intellectual Labor
posts.description: I think a lot about the nature of work, especially how it pertains to my own. What it comes down to, put simply, is whether one believes work to be zero-sum. As best I can tell, building software is decidedly not zero-sum. Jevons paradox applies here, but I’ll go even one step further: there will be not just more consumption, but compounding productivity.
